design: design_specification.md V10; objective_literature_audit.md; faithful published TaskAdam mechanism
objective: Same p/q weighted two-task BCE average. Per-task raw gradients sum to same objective gradient; wd/2 for each shared-task state; private gate/tower vanilla Adam. Changes optimizer map, not expected sample objective. Import captures optimizer source in config source_hashes.
numerical_validation: Reuse identical optimizer source official8step oracle <1e-12 plus private vanillaAdam and restore/raw-gradient identity; no redundant rerun.
scheduling: Frozen initial50epoch tasks, first2seeds only to limit interference with coreV4 extensions. Bothfull4seed master and remaining2seeds are required. Queue counts BOTH initialV4 andV9 predecessors, total<=5/GPU andmemory<90%.
budget_boundary: Initial50 fixedbudget is retained regardless laterextension. No elimination/state-necessity conclusion until full calibratedAdam andAdaTask matchedbudget readouts. If Adam duration increases, AdaTask must also supply that commonbudget (resume unchanged) before such comparison; adaptive durations reported separately. TaskAdam stepnorm change is a competing explanation, not automatically state mediation.
test: No test performance; conditional state-vs-stepscale discriminator only if complete paired comparison triggers.
analysis: Mechanical runner records raw results only; primary reviews fourseed evidence.
